architecture: LLM intent + explicit workflow compiler + precondition validation
scope: 6 development cases used for prompt revisions + 2 new-wording checks after freeze; one model run each; not W11 held-out, not repeated benchmark or general agent success
latency_protocol: wall time includes intent inference/one optional repair, compilation, model metadata HTTP reads; development machine, not a controlled speed benchmark
limitations: M0 adapter uses fixed labels/roles, not semantic ranking
source spans do not prove intent classification correctness
unquoted note punctuation may be included verbatim
first_iteration: real_model_v1 preserves CRM missing repeated email and Order illegal slot failures; not omitted from evidence
